images.name: Montreal Gateway Terminals Partnership
aliases: Terminaux Montréal Gateway Société en commandite
images.description: Montreal Gateway Terminals Partnership is a common-user marine container terminal operator at the Port of Montreal. It operates the Cast and Racine terminals as one intermodal platform, providing vessel, yard, reefer, storage, gate and rail/truck-transfer services to global shipping lines and cargo owners serving Canada and the U.S. Midwest and Northeast. The Port of Montreal reports effective handling capacity of 800,000 TEU at Cast and 500,000 TEU at Racine. A consortium led by Fiera Axium Infrastructure acquired 100% of the business from Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners on March 5, 2015; Fiera Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. was the disclosed Axium vehicle, but Axium's individual stake was not published. Axium's live portfolio continues to list the asset as operational. A 2025 debt refinancing identified FA MGT Limited Partnership as the parent but did not transfer equity. Public evidence reviewed did not support carrying the other 2015 consortium members forward as confirmed active owner rows, and no later sale or signed pending exit was found through August 18, 2026. Termont Montreal, the Port authority, and the individual Cast and Racine terminals are not separate companies within this record.

The consortium led by Fiera Axium Infrastructure completed its 100% acquisition from Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners; Fiera Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. was the disclosed Axium vehicle.
Montreal Gateway Terminals pursued a C$440 million senior-secured note refinancing through its FA MGT holding structure; the financing did not represent an equity transfer.
